findings.highlight: trying such shoddy work
findings.evidenceJa: こんな下衆なモノ仕掛けた
findings.governingReading: Rin dismisses the maker's skill level as irrelevant and condemns the vile thing installed in her territory.
findings.explanation: “Shoddy work” makes Rin criticize poor workmanship after she has dismissed skill level as irrelevant. The Japanese instead condemns the thing planted in her territory as vile.

findings.highlight: Our class is supposed to take care of World History
findings.evidenceJa: 世界史っていったらうちの担任じゃない
findings.governingReading: Rin recognizes World History as the subject taught by her homeroom teacher, Kuzuki.
findings.explanation: Rin's identification of her homeroom teacher becomes an assignment for her class. This belongs in a review of school relationships.

findings.highlight: It was near the end when everyone's answer sheets were already filled
findings.evidenceJa: みんながガァーっとマークシートを塗りつぶしてる時
findings.governingReading: Students were vigorously filling in their answer sheets when Kuzuki canceled the exam and announced a retake on a later date.
findings.explanation: The English makes Kuzuki interrupt an almost finished exam and schedule its replacement for the next day. The Japanese specifies neither, making the disruption less precisely defined.

findings.highlight: I have no way to dispel the Bounded Field itself
findings.evidenceJa: 呪刻そのものを撤去させる事はできない
findings.governingReading: She can temporarily erase the magical energy from this sigil but cannot remove the sigil itself; replenishing it will restore it.
findings.explanation: Rin's inability to remove the ritual sigil becomes an inability to dispel the entire Bounded Field.

findings.highlight: Not all people live to acquire things
findings.evidenceJa: 人間、生きていれば欲しい物なんて限りない
findings.governingReading: 人間、生きていれば欲しい物なんて限りない means people have no end of things to want while they are alive.
findings.explanation: Rin's observation that human wants are limitless becomes a claim that people do not live to acquire things.

findings.highlight: Oddly, Archer sounds just as put off
findings.evidenceJa: なぜか弾むような声で
findings.governingReading: Archer answers in an unexpectedly buoyant voice when agreeing not to imitate the energy-harvesting strategy.
findings.explanation: Archer's unexpectedly buoyant agreement becomes shared irritation, removing the lift in his response to Rin's refusal.

findings.highlight: There isn't time to even hesitate about jumping off the roof
findings.evidenceJa: 屋上だから思いっきり跳べない、なんて余裕はない
findings.governingReading: The source says she cannot spare a thought about limiting her jump because she is on a rooftop, then has her jump sideways toward the fence.
findings.explanation: Rin's lack of time to hesitate over how hard she can jump from a rooftop becomes hesitation about jumping off the roof.

findings.highlight: a pace no normal person can manage, much less clearly see
findings.evidenceJa: 常人なら残像しか見えない速度
findings.governingReading: 常人なら残像しか見えない速度 describes the observer's limited visual perception of her speed.
findings.explanation: Rin's hundred-meter sprint becomes a pace a normal person could not run rather than one they could only see as an afterimage.

findings.highlight: Don't hold back
findings.evidenceJa: 手助けはしないわ
findings.governingReading: 手助けはしないわ says she will not help him; she then tells him to show his power.
findings.explanation: Rin's explicit refusal to assist Archer becomes permission for him not to hold back.

findings.highlight: he's exploiting a weakness of spear tactics
findings.evidenceJa: 槍の基本戦術は払いにある
findings.governingReading: The narration explains that sweeping, rather than thrusting, is the spear's basic tactic because its broad reach prevents simple retreat.
findings.explanation: The explanation of spear sweeps becomes a statement that Archer exploits spear tactics. This concerns Lancer's weapon mechanics, not Assassin's swordcraft.

findings.highlight: end in impalement at the edge of the spear's range
findings.evidenceJa: 槍の長い柄に弾かれ
findings.governingReading: A reckless advance exposes Archer to a blow from the spear's long shaft that can crush his ribs.
findings.explanation: A rib-crushing blow from the spear's shaft becomes impalement. This is a separate error in Lancer's combat explanation.

findings.highlight: It's difficult to summon a Servant
findings.evidenceJa: それは召喚が難しいからでも
findings.governingReading: The sentence says it is neither because summoning is difficult nor because a Servant's abilities exceed a magus's; it is because a Servant itself exists above magecraft.
findings.explanation: A statement explicitly denying that summoning difficulty explains the Servant system is translated as saying Servants are difficult to summon.

findings.highlight: Lancer will stab him through the heart
findings.evidenceJa: ランサーに心臓を貫かれれば
findings.governingReading: ランサーに心臓を貫かれればアーチャーは死ぬ states the consequence if Lancer pierces his heart.
findings.explanation: Rin's conditional prediction that Archer will die if his heart is pierced becomes a definite prediction that Lancer will pierce it.

findings.highlight: a third party whom we've all overlooked
findings.evidenceJa: 偶然という第三者の登場
findings.governingReading: The narrator calls the third party 偶然, chance or coincidence, framing the student's arrival as an accidental interruption.
findings.explanation: Chance arriving as a third party becomes a person the characters had overlooked.

findings.highlight: I don't even have a way to heal my own wounds
findings.evidenceJa: こいつには自分で傷を癒すコトもできないし
findings.governingReading: The injured person cannot heal himself; Rin separately says she lacks sufficient power to save him.
findings.explanation: The injured person's inability to heal himself becomes Rin's inability to heal her own wounds. The allegation's identification of that person as Archer is unsupported here.

findings.highlight: his fault for having the dumb luck to be here tonight
findings.evidenceJa: 運悪く学校に残っていた
findings.governingReading: 運悪く学校に残っていた frames his presence as misfortune; Rin separately calls her own failure her responsibility.
findings.explanation: The student's bad luck at staying late becomes his fault for being here.

findings.highlight: Then I just need to help him the best I can
findings.evidenceJa: 出来うるだけの事をして、助けただけの話
findings.governingReading: The source states that he still had breath, so she did everything she could and saved him; this comes after she has restored him.
findings.explanation: Rin's completed rescue is translated as a plan to help him if he is still alive.

findings.highlight: I'm lying to myself
findings.evidenceJa: 思いっきり強がりを口にする
findings.governingReading: The narration calls her statement strong fronting, while she has just admitted feeling fulfilled and that the experience was not bad.
findings.explanation: Rin's bravado that she feels fulfilled is declared a lie to herself.

findings.highlight: has nothing to do with the Servant
findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントにとっても無関係じゃない
findings.governingReading: Rin realizes that a Master's wish also concerns the Servant, then wonders why her having no wish should trouble Archer when he has his own.
findings.explanation: Rin's acknowledgment that her wish also matters to her Servant becomes a denial that it concerns him. This reverses her initial understanding of Archer's condition for serving her.

findings.highlight: Not all people live to acquire things
findings.evidenceJa: 生きていれば欲しい物なんて限りない
findings.governingReading: The Japanese says people who live have endless things they will want; it explains why Rin can use the Grail later if she finds something she wants.
findings.explanation: Rin's account of limitless human wants becomes a claim that people do not live to acquire things.

findings.highlight: It's going to be as much of a struggle to rescue the guy now as it was to save him earlier
findings.evidenceJa: 助けた事も、これから助けに行く事も非難していた
findings.governingReading: Rin reports that Archer criticized both her earlier rescue and her decision to go help again.
findings.explanation: Rin's report that Archer criticized both rescues becomes a prediction about their difficulty. His spoken complaint remains, but its explicit scope is lost.

findings.highlight: We'll just have to jump over
findings.evidenceJa: 飛び越えて倒すしかない
findings.governingReading: 倒す says they must jump over and take Lancer down, deciding to deal with the consequences afterward.
findings.explanation: Rin's order to jump over the wall and defeat Lancer is reduced to jumping over it.

findings.highlight: I know that this is my dying moment
findings.evidenceJa: 死の間際で理解した
findings.governingReading: 死の間際で理解した marks when she understands; the next sentence says one glance was enough, followed by her identification of the strongest sword hero.
findings.explanation: Rin's understanding at the brink of death is changed into knowing that she is about to die.

findings.highlight: You'd think I'd go out hating my foe
findings.evidenceJa: わたしは敵を憎んだまま消え去るだろう
findings.governingReading: The Japanese presents shame, regret, and hatred as the emotions she expects to have as she dies, immediately contrasted with the fact that she feels nothing of the sort.
findings.explanation: Rin's predicted feelings of shame, regret, and hatred are made into what a reader would expect her to feel.
